jobs.occupation: Employees for fish production in 6855 Outrup
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job within fish production and enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced and professional production environment? Do you have experience from the fish or food industry and take pride in delivering high-quality work? If so, we would like to hear from you.

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

• 
Sorting, processing, and preparing fish products

• 
Filleting, trimming, and cutting fish

• 
Quality control and inspection of products

• 
Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

• 
Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

• 
Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

• 
Speak and understand English

• 
Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

• 
Have previous experience from fish production, food production, or a similar manufacturing environment

• 
Can work efficiently while maintaining a high level of quality

• 
Are able to follow strict hygiene, safety, and quality procedures

• 
Are reliable, punctual, and have a positive attitude towards teamwork

 

What We Offer

• 
A good and supportive working environment with colleagues from many different nationalities

• 
Thorough introduction and training

• 
Workwear and safety footwear provided by the company

• 
Access to a canteen with the option to purchase food

• 
The opportunity to gain valuable experience within a professional food production company

Salary: 143,40,- + 6,50,- per hour.

Important Information

Due to the location of the workplace and the early working hours, public transportation is not a realistic option, and it is therefore necessary that you have your own reliable means of transportation to and from work.

Due to strict hygiene and food safety requirements, jewelry, piercings, artificial nails, and artificial eyelashes are not permitted in the production area.

If you are looking for long-term employment in a professional production environment and have experience from the fish or food industry, we encourage you to apply. We are looking for employees who are ready to contribute, work as part of a team, and help maintain the high standards our customer is known for.

Interested? We conduct ongoing interviews and look forward to receiving your application.

Junior Software Tester

Company: Node16 ApS (Node16.ai)Location: Frederiksberg, Copenhagen, DenmarkEmployment: Full-time, 37 hours per weekStart date: 1 February 2027Reporting to: Henrik Axelsen, CEO

About Node16.ai

Node16.ai is an early-stage Danish technology company developing privacy-preserving artificial intelligence solutions for the financial services industry.

Our mission is to improve the detection and prevention of financial crime by enabling financial institutions to collaborate and share intelligence without compromising sensitive customer and transaction data.

By combining artificial intelligence, federated learning and modern software infrastructure, we aim to make anti-money laundering (AML) processes more effective, secure and scalable.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Tester to join our growing team and contribute to the quality, reliability and functionality of our software products.

About the role

As a Junior Software Tester at Node16.ai, you will support the testing and quality assurance of the company’s web applications and software systems.

You will work closely with developers and product stakeholders to prepare and execute software tests, identify and document defects, verify fixes, and support the delivery of reliable software solutions.

This position offers an opportunity to develop practical experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation within an innovative AI-driven technology company.

Key responsibilities

•           Software testing: Prepare and execute functional, regression and integration tests to verify that applications and software systems operate according to specified requirements.

•           Test case preparation and documentation: Create, maintain and update test cases, test checklists and testing documentation, including recorded results and observations.

•           Defect identification and verification: Identify, reproduce, document and report software defects, and verify that reported issues have been resolved.

•           Quality assurance and release support: Assist in validating software features, reviewing test results and supporting quality assurance activities throughout software development and releases.

•           Test automation support: Execute, maintain, and update automated test scripts and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines and data workflows.

•           Cross-functional collaboration: Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and release validation alongside developers and product stakeholders.

Qualifications and skills

We are looking for a candidate with:

•           An educational background in computer science, software engineering, information technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

•           A basic understanding of software testing and the software development lifecycle.

•           An understanding of web applications and general software functionality.

•           Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

•           Attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

•           The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small team.

•           Fluent written and spoken English.

•           A willingness to learn new technologies and testing methodologies.

Recent graduates and candidates at the beginning of their software testing or quality assurance careers are encouraged to apply. Prior professional experience is not required.

Desirable qualifications

The following skills and experience would be advantageous but are not mandatory:

•           Basic knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript.

•           Familiarity with API testing, SQL or data validation.

•           Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines and Agile development methodologies.

•           An interest in artificial intelligence, financial technology, data privacy or financial crime prevention.

What we offer

•           An opportunity to contribute to an innovative Danish AI and financial technology company.

•           Hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation.

•           Exposure to modern software development practices and AI-driven applications.

•           Close collaboration with the CEO and technical team.

•           Opportunities for professional development as the company grows.

•           Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish standards.

Employment details

Job title: Junior Software TesterEmployment type: Full-timeWeekly working hours: 37 hours per weekStart date: 1 February 2027Workplace: Porcelænshaven 26, 2000 Frederiksberg, DenmarkWorking language: English

How to apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a brief cover letter outlining their qualifications and motivation for joining Node16.ai.

Please submit your application by email to:

Henrik AxelsenCEO, Node16 ApSEmail: henrik@node16.aiEmail subject: Application: Junior Software Tester

Application deadline: 10 December 2026

Applications are welcomed from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and nationalities.

jobs.occupation: Hotel Allrounder (Bar, F&B, Reception all in one role)
jobs.description:
Hospitality job in Copenhagen. One role, many hats. No two days alike.  Love good coffee, great drinks and even better conversation? Want a hotel job where no day feels the same? Keep reading.   Most hotel jobs put you in one spot. At Zoku, you’ll be everywhere that matters. 

From welcoming guests and sharing local tips to serving great food, making coffee, and mixing cocktails, you’ll help create the experience people remember long after they’ve checked out. If variety is your thing and making people feel genuinely at home comes naturally to you, you might be exactly who we’re looking for. 

At Zoku, we’re not your typical hotel. We’re a community-driven space where people can live, work, socialize, and connect with the city around them. We believe hospitality should feel personal, human, and effortless and that starts with the people on our team. That’s where you come in! 

WHAT IS A SIDEKICK?  

At Zoku, we call our hospitality all-rounders “Sidekicks”. You can think of this role as a Guest Experience Host: someone who combines reception, restaurant, bar, and guest services into one dynamic hospitality role. You’re the friendly face welcoming guests at check in, the person recommending your favorite local spots, the bartender making someone’s evening, and the host creating a warm atmosphere in our rooftop Living Kitchen restaurant. 

No two days are the same and that’s exactly why people love this role. 

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO 

Behind the bar. Pull espressos in the morning, pour craft beer in the afternoon, shake cocktails at night. We'll teach you the recipes, you bring the chat. 

In the restaurant. Serve breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites in our Living Kitchen and on our rooftop terraces with great views over the city. Guide guests to the right wine, the right small plate, the right table. 

At the front desk. Welcome arriving guests, handle check-ins & check-outs, and answer the inevitable "where's the best bakery in Copenhagen?" with the kind of tips only a local would know. 

YOUR SCHEDULE 

You’ll work independently across different departments, with both morning and afternoon/evening shifts. A standard shift is 8 hours with a 30 minute meal break. Your responsibilities and hours may vary.

• 
Morning Shift (AM Shift): 07:00 to 15:00 (+/- 1 hour)

• 
Afternoon/Evening Shift (PM Shift): 15:00 to 23:00 (+/- 1 hour)

YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU 

• 
Are genuinely friendly, and open. 

• 
Love creating unforgettable stays where guests feel a true sense of belonging. 

• 
Thrive in social, energetic environments. 

• 
Like variety and can easily switch between different tasks. 

• 
Are proactive, hands on, and team oriented. 

• 
Have a genuine interest in hospitality, food, drinks, travel, or community. 

• 
Love discovering and sharing the best spots in Copenhagen. 

 

A FEW MUST HAVES 

• 
You have worked in hospitality or in a similar customer-facing industry.

• 
You are fluent in English - Danish and any other languages are a big plus!

• 
You are an EU resident or have a valid working and living permit to work in Denmark.

• 
You have a CPR-number / tax number and a Danish bank account.

• 
You are flexible, as there are no fixed working days / hours and enjoy working both week days and weekends.

• 
You are available to work either 32 hours weekly (4 shifts) or 37 hours weekly (Full Time-5 Shifts).

 

Start date: We’re ready to welcome our next Sidekick as soon as possible! We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t snooze, apply today! We’re all about finding the right match for our amazing team.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

• 
We’ll screen applications as they are submitted.

• 
We’ll give you a call to for a quick get to know each other chat.

• 
We’ll invite you in for either 1 or 2 interviews to get a tour of Zoku and meet the Team.

• 
We’ll finalize the offer and get you started!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

You’ll join an international team filled with people who genuinely care about hospitality, creativity, and community. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey! 

• 
A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

• 
A 40% discount on food & drinks for you and up to 4 friends 

• 
Discounted Employee- and Friends & Family rates across all Zoku locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Vienna and Paris) 

• 
The best staff meals, enjoyed in our rooftop Social Spaces overlooking the city. 

• 
A free night stay for you and a +1 in your first 3 months – plus another free night at any Zoku location for your birthday celebration 

• 
Access to all community events, team celebrations, and after work drinks 

• 
Exciting on-the-job training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

• 
A personal budget after your first year: spend it on extra days off, learning, or take it as cash  

Check out all benefits here.  

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Zoku combines the energy of a lifestyle brand with the warmth of a close knit team. We challenge traditional hospitality by creating spaces where people genuinely connect, whether they’re staying for one night or several months. 

Next to our award-winning design and our global press fan club, we’re proud to be a certified B Corp across all our locations, meaning we care deeply about people, community, and doing business with a heart (not just as a marketing line). 

WHAT THE ZOKU?!  We’re Zoku. Designed for the new generation of business travelers, we’re so much more than a long stay hotel. We’re a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. We’ve created a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so you can stay connected and well rested as you live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities. It will be your home city next.  READY? Hit apply and tell us why this role has your name on it.
